recommendation: Keep the audit commit and do not reapply the 2015 DAF removal. Any future removal or rename of the broader Condition-subject search parameter should be handled by a new current-version Patient Care/FHIR-I decision.
issue_request: FHIR-8142 is a Published/Persuasive Patient Care DAF ballot issue asking to remove subject from valid Condition search parameters because patient replaced it; the resolution says to rename subject search parameter to patient.
initial_application: No current git commit mentions FHIR-8142 directly. The same search-parameter request appears in FHIR-6094, which has the same 2015 Patient Care vote date and svn revision 5891; git commit 584064415b304f98fd1074e03db8e78fba0dba2b removed the subject search parameter from the old Condition.patient model.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini actively includes Condition, source/condition/structuredefinition-Condition.xml defines Condition.subject as Reference(Patient|Group) with alias patient, and source/condition/bundle-Condition-search-params.xml defines both Condition-patient and Condition-subject. Git commit e35d3b3f92f11757466373e8b8f9f829d96d5cc9 reintroduced Condition.subject and subject search when the model broadened to Patient|Group. FHIR-31714 later supports Patient-only target-constrained patient searches, and a 2019 Zulip thread explains the current patient-vs-subject distinction.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Removing Condition-subject now would delete the broader Group-capable search parameter and would contradict the current Condition.subject model.
